cards.card_text: So Herod has Peter, one of Jesus' twelve apostles (Matthew 10:2), arrested during the Feast of Unleavened Bread.
cards.verse_text: And seeing that this pleased the Jews, Herod proceeded to seize Peter during the Feast of Unleavened Bread.
cards.snippet: …that this pleased the Jews, Herod proceeded to seize Peter during the Feast of Unleavened Bread.

cards.card_text: Then Paul calls food, drink, feasts, New Moons and Sabbaths a shadow of the things to come.
cards.verse_text: Therefore let no one judge you by what you eat or drink, or with regard to a feast, a New Moon, or a Sabbath.
cards.snippet: …you by what you eat or drink, or with regard to a feast, a New Moon, or a Sabbath.

cards.verse_text: They are blots and blemishes, reveling in their deception as they feast with you.

cards.card_text: They're hidden reefs in their love feasts, shamelessly feasting with them.
cards.verse_text: These men are hidden reefs in your love feasts, shamelessly feasting with you but shepherding only themselves.
